How to play A quick start

Look aroundDrag the 3D puzzle to orbit. Scroll the mouse wheel to zoom.Pinch with two fingers to zoom. The view changes; the puzzle does not.

Select an axisClickTap a ring, axis label, or axis button. Repeated clickstaps on a 3D tile cycle its axes, then clear the selection.

Turn the puzzleDrag along a ring, or use ↶ Rotate / Rotate ↷ below the 3D view. The arrows mean counterclockwise / clockwise looking inward from the selected axis.

Connect the viewsHover over a 3D tile to outline its ring-map node.In Constrained Solver, tap either a 3D tile or its ring-map node to make the same selection. ClickTap empty ring-map space to deselect the axis.

Scramble or solveRandomize scrambles the current state. Auto Solve works through it in stages. Stop once to finish the stage; twice to finish just the current move.

Try a constrained swapUse Hold to protect node colors. Choose a tile for Swap ① and Swap ②, then Go. Clear releases holds; Suggest chooses holds for you.

Replay your movesThe player steps backward or forward through moves or whole sequences. Stop ends playback after the current move.

Find helpShow guide opens this puzzle’s solution. The solving handbook explains every control, solver, and algorithm.

Solving handbook ↗Controls, algorithms, and a complete 2×2×2 worked example.
